def _ensure_programmer_executable():
    """ Find the lpc21isp executable and ensure it is executable
    """
    import os
    import stat
    import shutil
    import sys

    lpc21isp_exe = "lpc21isp"
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        lpc21isp_exe = "lpc21isp.exe"

    lpc21isp_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), lpc21isp_exe)

    if not os.path.exists(lpc21isp_path):
        raise IOError("Could not find the lpc21isp executable. "
                      "Please install it from http://www.lpcware.com/content/downloads")

    if not os.access(lpc21isp_path, os.X_OK):
        print("Making lpc21isp executable")
        st = os.stat(lpc21isp_path)
        os.chmod(lpc21isp_path, st.st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC)

    return lpc21isp_path

def _ensure_programmer_files():
    """ Copy the programmer files to the current directory
    """
    import shutil
    import os

    programmer_files = [
        "lpc21isp.cfg",
        "lpc21isp_stk500.cfg",
        "lpc21isp_stk600.cfg",
    ]

    lpc21isp_path = _ensure_programmer_executable()

    for f in programmer_files:
        src = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(lpc21isp_path), f)
        dst = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), f)
        print("Copying %s to %s" % (src, dst))
        shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
